WITH rpt_users AS (
SELECT src.id, src.organization_id, src.name, src.first_name, src.last_name, src.work_email, src.role_name, src.is_active FROM (
SELECT 
  u.id,
  u.organization_id,
  u.first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(u.last_name, '') AS name,
  u.first_name,
  u.last_name,
  u.work_email,
  r.name AS role_name,
  (u.status = 'active') AS is_active
FROM accounts.setup_users u
JOIN accounts.setup_user_product_access upa ON upa.user_id = u.id AND upa.product_id = 'crm'
JOIN accounts.setup_roles r ON r.id = upa.role_id
WHERE u.organization_id = %(_org_id)s
) src WHERE TRUE
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rpt_users AS users WHERE role_name ILIKE '%%agent%%' LIMIT 500
